channel.title: The Graham Norton Show
channel.desc: Together on Graham's sofa tonight: Hollywood star Chris Pratt, in new AI thriller Mercy; Wicked star Cynthia Erivo, playing all 23 roles in a new stage production of Dracula; comedian and writer Dawn French, in new BBC sitcom Can You Keep a Secret?; and top comic Rob Beckett. With music from singer-songwriter Jack Savoretti.
